parts:
Hello Genomic SEM users,

I have been facing a  issue with commonfactorGWAS function. 
Basically I have been implementing the tutorial https://github.com/MichelNivard/GenomicSEM/wiki/4.-Common-Factor-GWAS

I was able to reproduce sumstats function with serial processing (paralleling processing as suggested took a considerable amount of time, RAM for my macbook pro leading to eventual system hang and shutdown)
For common Factor GWAS, however , the function is unable to execute when trying on R studio. I tried executing with both parallel and serial processing but all in vain.

Kindly let me know if anyone has faced this issue

Screenshot of the Rstudio browser where I am trying to execute commonfactor gwas function since yesterday is attached below


Best Regards
Shreyali Ganvir

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Not able to execute commonfactorGWAS function when I combine the summary statistics and LDSC output
parts:
Hi Shreyali, 

In general, the GWAS functions will be difficult to run in a single go on a laptop and are ideally executed on a computing cluster. The ability to run on a laptop in general is going to depend on the number of cores available, the number of traits being analyzed, and the number of SNPs left are running the sumstats function. Based on your screenshot, it looks like you are running the 5-indicator p-factor example from the github wiki. If you don't have access to a computing cluster, I might suggest trying to run 100k SNPs just to get a sense of overall run time. 

Best, 
  Andrew
